title: Sherman's mother abducted and fetus 'genetically managed'

tellings.quote: And so in 1963 when she was uh when she was um uh had me you know in term um they abducted her again and they uh did the genetic management.

plain: Dan Sherman, a former Air Force sergeant who says the NSA hired him to communicate with aliens, says his mother was abducted by aliens in the early 1960s. He says they took her again in 1963, while she was pregnant with him, and "did the genetic management" on him before he was born. Sherman tells Michels he learned this from a man he calls Captain White, and he offers it as the reason he was able to receive messages from them later.
